entities.name: PMID:25443010
observations: Ratschiller et al. reported first clinical experience with the Contour 3D annuloplasty ring for functional tricuspid regurgitation in 200 consecutive patients.
Retrospective single-institution series; follow-up was 98% complete, mean 1.0 ± 0.7 years, totaling 189 patient-years.
Tricuspid regurgitation grade decreased from 2.45 ± 0.53 preoperatively to 0.77 ± 0.54 postoperatively; 30-day mortality was 6%.
Residual grade II or greater tricuspid regurgitation occurred in 4.3% at discharge; freedom from recurrent grade II or greater regurgitation at 2 years was 90.9% ± 4.2%.
Freedom from tricuspid-valve-related reoperation at 2 years was 98.5% ± 1.0%; no ring dehiscence occurred; permanent pacemaker implantation was required in 7%.

entities.name: Contour 3D ring
observations: Medtronic Contour 3D annuloplasty ring used for tricuspid valve repair in the reported functional tricuspid regurgitation series.

entities.name: Functional tricuspid regurgitation
observations: The study evaluated surgical tricuspid valve repair for functional tricuspid regurgitation using the Contour 3D annuloplasty ring.
